utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have you checked if we have enough screws? Cleo's been counting them, but I hope we're not missing any.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll double-check with Cleo to see how many screws we have.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, let me know if we need to buy more before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got my wrenches and screwdrivers ready to lend.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. Remember it's Saturday at the community center on 5th St.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Saturday at the community center on 5th St., got it. I'll bring my tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Vik! Just a reminder, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. I'm helping out, and Nell and Gus are pitching in too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: So it's Saturday at the community center, right? And Cleo's handling the parts inventory.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I didn't know Cleo was helping with parts! That's great—the more, the merrier.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Uli, I've been tallying the supplies for Saturday's repair drive at the community center. We're making good progress.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I brought some tools from my shed, hope they help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli! Every tool helps. Rosa wants a list of needed supplies—I'll add those to my tally.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, just a reminder the repair drive is this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center on 5th Street. I'm grabbing flyers to post at the coffee shop and library.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I'll swing by with my stuff sometime Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, looking forward to seeing you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive? That sounds like a great way to get to know folks. Mina's organizing it, right? I could probably lend a hand with some basic fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Eli's coming too, and Gus is bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's good to know, Gus always has the right tools. Have you heard what time we're starting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, are you coming to the repair drive on Sunday? I'll be organizing tools with Uli.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The drive is Saturday, not Sunday. But yes, I'll be there to fix furniture and doors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Actually, I'm pretty sure it's Sunday. Uli and I are planning to organize tools then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, the repair drive? I'll try to make it on time this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Eli will be there too—I'm bringing snacks for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, I'll see you at the community center on 5th Street at 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I heard about the repair drive. How can I help get the word out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You could help by posting flyers! Jules usually does that at the coffee shop and library.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great idea! I'll grab some flyers and put them up at the community center as well.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard Rey is gathering tools for the drive, sounds like things are coming together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, Gus said he's got some wrenches and a drill ready too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, sounds like we're getting a good collection of tools. Are we still on for Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mina, the repair drive is at the community center today; Gus is lending wrenches and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, the repair drive is on Saturday, not today. Did you get the date mixed up?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No, I'm sure I saw the flyer—it's definitely today. I just came from there; Tess is already fixing things.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about this repair drive? I heard Quinn mention it, but I need confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, it's definitely scheduled for this Saturday at the community center. Cleo's been keeping track of the parts we have.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Cleo mentioned needing to double-check the wood glue count—has she confirmed that yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday? I'll be there helping out, and Nell's gonna fix small electronics and do some sewing too!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Tess dear, I think the repair drive is actually on Sunday at the community center. Sam's helping organize the tools too!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, are you sure? I thought it was Saturday—Gus is lending his wrenches and screwdrivers for that day.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly needs fixing around here? I heard Eli can handle the squeaky doors.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! It's this Saturday at the community center. Cleo's keeping track of parts, so check with her for what we need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I'll talk to Cleo. But what's the main job you want me on—carpentry or something else?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have enough screws for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a box of assorted screws in my garage; I'll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good, but could you check if they're the right sizes? We don't want to run out halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Almost done with the supply tally, just need a few more numbers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, let me know if you need me to pick up anything on my errands today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, could you grab some extra duct tape and a few more screwdrivers? We're running low.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'll grab some flyers and post them at the coffee shop and library to spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great idea! Make sure the flyers mention we're at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it, I'll make sure the address is right on them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Noah, are you coming to the repair drive this Sunday at the community center? I'll be helping Uli organize the tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think I'll be there. I heard Eli's coming too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, the more the merrier.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I'm late. Is the repair drive still set for Saturday at 10 at the community center on 5th Street?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that's right. Sam will be there organizing tools, and Jules posted flyers around town.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I'll be there. Do we need to bring our own tools?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to double-check, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center on 5th Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, that's right. I heard Eli will be there, and Gus is bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, and Cleo will manage the parts inventory.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, I'm good for dropping off my stuff for the repair drive. Just let me know when.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Bo! You can drop things off anytime Saturday morning—Eli will be there to collect them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I'll swing by Saturday morning. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we have everything we need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Don't worry, I've been telling everyone about it! We'll have plenty of folks showing up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But are we actually sure about the supplies? I heard Cleo's still counting the wood glue.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Uli, I heard about the repair drive from Mina. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's at the community center, a chance for folks to fix things together. I'm bringing some tools over later.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great! What kind of tools are you bringing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, just a reminder the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. Oh, and Cleo is handling the parts inventory.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. Uli brought extra wrenches, and Rosa has the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, so Saturday at the community center for the repair drive. Cleo's on parts, and we have Uli's wrenches and Rosa's list.
